findings: REWORK-4-AUTHORIZING-RESULT-BINDING: When resolving previous_rework_contract_id, retain the existing strict ReworkContract envelope, payload, canonical content-ID, filename, task, iteration, expected-HEAD and timestamp checks, then require architect-review-results/{authorizing_review_result_id}.json to exist. Parse its exact architect_review_result envelope through the canonical ArchitectReviewResult parser, verify the parsed result identity equals both its canonical digest and authorizing_review_result_id, and require disposition FAIL. Bind the ReworkContract exactly to that result: contract.task_id equals result.task_id; contract.review_iteration equals result.review_iteration + 1; contract.findings equals the existing deterministic fingerprint:rule_id:action_id projection of result.findings; allowed_rework_scope and required_validations equal the result values without widening or reordering; and contract.created_at equals result.created_at. Bind contract.expected_head to the persisted PUBLISHED FAIL lifecycle-projection event for the same task and review_result_id, requiring event disposition FAIL, expected_parent equal result.expected_head, and projection_commit equal contract.expected_head. Reject missing, ambiguous, malformed, PASS/BLOCKED, wrong-ID, wrong-task, wrong-iteration, stale-HEAD, changed-finding, changed-scope, changed-validator, changed-timestamp, wrong-projection or internally recomputed forged authority. A self-consistent contract ID and matching filename alone must never authorize lineage.
